original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the exact BMC WebUI POST Code Logs page exports the complete owner-defined POST-code dataset as a readable file.
original_method: An authorized operator performs Export all on the dedicated page and confirms the downloaded artifact; automation hashes/parses it and may collect complete read-only SEL/POST sources only as separately documented corroboration.
manual_activity: An authorized operator must perform/confirm the dedicated WebUI export and downloaded file; automation may analyze it and collect corroboration but cannot infer success from SEL text.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/SUT/WebUI version and POST Code page identity
Expected export format, headers, encoding, POST code width/order, timestamp and complete scope
Operator download and access-controlled evidence directory
Documented source/backend for POST logs and any mapping to SEL record fields
Policy for empty log, repeated codes, boot-session boundaries and vendor descriptions
safety_requirements: Never clear/delete/acknowledge POST logs or SEL or alter BMC settings
Do not expose credentials, session tokens or sensitive platform/fault data
Preserve original export and complete corroborating sources; redact only derived copies
Stop on wrong BMC, truncated/unreadable file or unsupported source mapping
No automatic repeat that overwrites the artifact or changes boot-session scope
agent_execution_scope: Hash and parse the confirmed export into boot sessions and POST entries
Collect complete read-only corroborating source only when its mapping is documented
Report non-equivalence and unmatched entries without forcing a merge
Make no UI-action claim, log mutation, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve POST export schema/scope and SEL/non-SEL source mapping
Provide/confirm operator export and raw file custody
Review completeness/mapping discrepancies and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool sel list | grep POST` can be corroboration only: textual grep misses numeric/vendor encodings and cannot prove the dedicated page's export occurred or is complete; command-line secrets are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Analyze the actual operator-confirmed WebUI export. If an approved SEL mapping exists, collect the complete SEL securely and structurally decode POST entries; otherwise document non-equivalence instead of inventing coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Logs/POST code logs navigation, Export all action, successful export criterion and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HYBRID DEDICATED POST-LOG EXPORT WITH DOCUMENTED CORROBORATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash/parse the raw export, segment entries by boot/session when available, verify complete schema/count, and compare only against a formally mapped raw POST/SEL backend while recording non-equivalence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces grep-based assumed equivalence with primary UI artifact validation and source-aware comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: POST codes may be numeric, OEM-decoded or stored outside SEL; grep can return zero despite a valid full export or omit most entries while appearing plausible.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Without a documented backend mapping, SEL and the POST page are independent datasets. The export can still be validated for integrity/scope, but cross-source equality must not be claimed.

project_override_considerations: WebUI-version-specific columns, code descriptions or boot grouping may be normalized only by an approved schema; the UI artifact remains mandatory and cannot be replaced by SEL.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/SUT/WebUI/page identity, operator and export timestamp
Parsed code/order/session/timestamp fields and completeness result
Complete corroborating source plus documented mapping or explicit non-equivalence
No log/BMC mutation, secure-access/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require dedicated WebUI POST-log export. DeepSeek's SEL grep is incomplete corroboration, not a conflicting source requirement.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authorized Web export, schema and mapping inputs gate execution; an operator can perform the action, so the static review is complete and not globally blocked.

review_improvement: Preserves the dedicated WebUI export and explicitly prevents SEL grep from substituting for the primary POST-log artifact.
independent_technical_reasoning: POST-code logs are often numeric or vendor-decoded and may be stored in a backend distinct from IPMI SEL. Searching rendered SEL text for the word POST therefore has neither a known denominator nor a reliable encoding map. The only direct proof of this testcase is the downloaded dedicated-page artifact; corroboration is valid only after documenting how its code/session fields map to another source.
